name: Formosan Rubber Group Inc.
summary: Formosan Rubber Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, produces and markets rubber sheets, plastic sheets, plastic foam sheets, PVC resin sheets, and related materials. The company offers rubber, silicone rubber, laminated, PU coating, PVC, and green plastic products. It also engages in the development of residential and commercial buildings for renting and selling purposes; and management of logistics storage business. The company products are used in various applications, including functional garments and fabrics, healthcare, industrial and safety products, inflatable products, and optical electronic materials, as well as for use in shoes, and bags and luggage products.
